rows.note: This is the all-purpose formal term, especially in written or technical contexts, for something descriptive rather than prescriptive.

example.english: This paper uses a descriptive approach to analyse Cantonese grammar.
example.traditional: 呢篇論文採用描述性方法分析粵語語法。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 leon6 man4 coi2 jung6 miu4 seot6 sing3 fong1 faat3 fan1 sik1 jyut6 jyu5 jyu5 faat3

rows.note: Use this conversational phrasing when saying that something is used to describe an attribute, rather than naming a linguistic category or theoretical approach.

example.english: The word “tall” is descriptive and is used to describe a person’s height.
example.traditional: 呢個「高」字係用嚟形容人嘅身高嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gou1 zi6 hai6 jung6 lei4 jing4 jung4 jan4 ge3 san1 gou1 ge3
